senses.nuances: 人名应写作 Victor。英语普通名词 victor 另有“胜利者”之义，不能仅凭输入排名断定是哪一种。英语人名可读 /ˈvɪk.tə/ 或 /ˈvɪk.tɚ/；本人可能采用其他语言读音。以下为人名称谓示例。

etymology.historical_story: Victor began as a Roman name associated with the Latin word for a victor or conqueror. It became established in Christian naming traditions and spread across several European languages. The same spelling therefore has both a personal-name history and an English common-noun use. Neither history alone identifies the function of an isolated token in a Malay corpus.
